The '''1973–74 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by four points over nearest rival [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]]. [[East Fife F.C.|East Fife]] and [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1974–75 Scottish Division Two|1974–75 Second Division]].

This was Celtic's [[Nine in a row|ninth title in a row]], a record that would be equalled by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] in the [[1996–97 Scottish Premier Division|1996–97]] season and again by Celtic themselves in [[2019–20 Scottish Premiership|2019–20]].
